description: This file defines a React-like component named 'Home' for a travel application frontend. It uses LightningJS for rendering UI components, imports several subcomponents (NavBar, Hero, DestinationList), and fetches destination data asynchronously on component load.

classes.name: Component
classes.description: A LightningJS component named 'Home' that composes UI and manages state.

methods.name: ready
methods.description: An asynchronous hook that loads destination data when the component is ready.
